_comment: One verse card per plate of Doré's Bible Gallery (1866). render.js builds
each one from verse-card.template.html — there are no per-card HTML files.
plate   plate number in the Gutenberg edition; picks the file in art/
ref     Scripture reference, printed on the card
verse   ESV text. Every card is a contiguous quote of its verse, checked by
check_verses.py; keep it that way. See PROOFING.md.
hook    the line of product copy printed on the navy plate. One per card
and no two alike, each tied to the verse above it.
angle   which of the ~10 product angles the card argues. Not printed —
this is the grouping key for building an ad set (see ad_copy.md).
tier    'ad'      cleared for paid placement
'organic' fine on the grid, wrong for a cold paid audience —
violence, corpses, or a scene that needs its context
'hold'    do not publish without a decision from a human first
place   'top' or 'bottom', whichever band of the plate covers less of
Doré's line work — some subjects sit too high to crop clear
bright  exposure, so every plate lands on the same mood
scrim   0-1, how hard the plate is darkened under the verse
focus   object-position for the crop, 'X% Y%'
long    true drops the verse from 76px to 66px (past ~90 characters)
place/bright/scrim/focus/long are computed by tune_cards.py and written back
here, so they stay reviewable and the render stays deterministic. Re-run it
after changing a verse; hand edits to those five fields will be overwritten.
ref/verse/hook/angle/tier are written by hand and are never touched.
